network_status.summary_it: Il dossier regionale identifica gli interventi sul Chioma e la ricostruzione dei ponti dopo l'alluvione di Livorno, ma non pubblica una serie o un valore idrometrico evento-specifico alla foce del Chioma. Le portate di progetto presenti nella pianificazione idraulica non vengono presentate come osservazioni del 2017.
network_status.summary_en: The regional dossier identifies works on the Chioma and bridge reconstruction after the Livorno flood, but publishes no event-specific hydrometric series or value at the Chioma mouth. Design flows in hydraulic planning are not presented as 2017 observations.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
